header.text: <instructions>Read a text about Lou Gehrig.</instructions>

contents.text: Lou Gehrig played baseball for the New York Yankees from 1923 to 1939. Gehrig was such a hard worker that people called him the Iron Horse. He played 2,130 games in a row! He wasn't famous just because he worked hard, though. He was also famous because of his batting skills. He hit many home runs, and he helped his team win six World Series. Although he died in 1941, Gehrig is still remembered for his baseball greatness.
Select the two details that are included in the text.

Lou Gehrig was known as the Iron Horse because he worked so hard at baseball.

header.text: <instructions>Read a text about Knitting Behind Bars.</instructions>

contents.text: Lynn Zwerling wanted to teach a knitting class to men who were in jail. She felt that they would find it fun and educational. Zwerling had been right all along; the men enjoyed the craft.

header.text: <instructions>Read a text about food for deer.</instructions>

contents.text: In the winter, some people worry that wild deer don't have enough to eat. To help, they may hang corn feeders from their trees. Deer love corn, but corn feeders really aren't a good idea. First, corn is not a healthy winter food for deer. Deer should mainly eat small twigs and tree branches in the winter. Another problem with corn feeders is that they can bring deer closer together. This makes it easier for them to spread illness to one another. It's best not to feed wild deer.

pieces.text: From cave drawings to photos, pictures can often say more than words alone. This is one reason why people use emojis. Emojis are small pictures often used in text messages and email. They are used to show a feeling or idea. These little pictures of faces, objects, and animals got their start in Japan. The word
comes from the Japanese words for "picture" and "character."

textContent.text: In the 1990s, it took a long time to write text messages on the first cell phones. A Japanese man named Shigetaka Kurita thought it would be faster and easier to send messages using pictures. Instead of typing "It is sunny today," you could just use a picture of the sun. Kurita came up with 176 digital pictures that became the first emojis. There were hearts, happy and sad faces, and pictures showing different kinds of weather. The emojis were fast to type and easy to understand. They could also add extra information about how the writer was feeling.
Emojis were an instant hit. People loved using emojis so much that they asked for new ones to be made. Now, there are thousands of different emojis, including ones for pizza, basketball, and animals.

Using pictures in messages can carry ideas across the world. Even people who do not speak the same language can communicate with emojis. A smiling face means happy thoughts whether you speak English or Japanese!

textContent.text: Duct tape is a special kind of tape with an interesting history. During World War II, soldiers needed a way to keep things in boxes from getting wet. A factory worker named Vesta Stoudt figured out what to do. She made a waterproof tape that kept the boxes closed and the contents dry. The tape was made of three parts. It had a waterproof plastic top, cloth in the middle, and sticky glue on the bottom.

The soldiers thought the tape was great, and they started using it for many things. They called it "duck" tape for two reasons. First, water rolled off it just like water rolls off a duck's feathers. Also, it was made out of a cloth called cotton duck. Soon soldiers started using "duck" tape to fix boots, trucks, and even planes!

textContent.text: Duct tape is a special kind of tape with an interesting history. During World War II, soldiers needed a way to keep things in boxes from getting wet. A factory worker named Vesta Stoudt figured out what to do. She made a waterproof tape that kept the boxes closed and the contents dry. The tape was made of three parts. It had a waterproof plastic top, cloth in the middle, and sticky glue on the bottom.

The soldiers thought the tape was great, and they started using it for many things. They called it "duck" tape for two reasons. First, water rolled off it just like water rolls off a duck's feathers. Also, it was made out of a cloth called cotton duck. Soon soldiers started using "duck" tape to fix boots, trucks, and even planes!

textContent.text: The automobile changed life for people in the United States. The first automobiles were sold early in the 1900s. Before the automobile, people traveled by horse. They rarely went more than a few miles a day. Cars helped people move easily to different places. Now, they could go on vacations farther away.

Besides changing people's personal lives in many ways, the automobile also brought huge changes to American business. Certain businesses began to make a lot of money. For example, a special type of rubber had just been invented. It was very strong and could handle big temperature changes. Companies made good money selling this rubber for car tires. People who sold gasoline also had large profits. Gasoline was needed to keep the cars going, so gas stations popped up everywhere.

, were built along new roads. These were places where people could stop and spend the night. People on long road trips got hungry, too. They wanted a place to make a quick stop for cheap and filling food. Diners became common places to eat. Diners made hamburgers, french fries, and milkshakes famous in the United States. These are still some of the most regularly eaten items on road trips today.

People enjoy riding carousels, or merry-go-rounds, all over the world. Today, a carousel is a type of ride that spins around and around. Riders sit on wooden animals that move up and down while the carousel turns. But the word

used to be a name for different games that were played while riding horses. In one of these games, riders tried to put a long pole through a ring that hung from a tree. A man in France decided to build a wooden circle with pretend horses to help people practice the game. His innovation became the first carousel.

textContent.text: The first practice carousels were very small. They had only one or two wooden horses. There were no motors, so a person, or sometimes a horse, had to push the carousel to make it turn. Still, many people enjoyed watching riders practice getting a pole through a ring while sitting on pretend horses. They thought the machine looked like fun to ride. Soon, small carousels were being built for fairs all over Europe.

In the 1800s, an Englishman built a carousel powered by a steam engine. This brought big changes to the little ride! Thanks to steam power, carousels were able to spin much faster. In America, people designed carousel horses that could move up and down as they went around in a circle. Steam-powered carousels were also able to carry the weight of many more horses and riders.

Today's carousels run on electric motors and have mirrors, lights, music, and beautifully painted animals. There have been many changes over the years to the way carousels work and look. But the joy carousels bring to riders is one thing that has not changed.

used to be a name for different games that were played while riding horses. In one of these games, riders tried to put a long pole through a ring that hung from a tree. A man in France decided to build a wooden circle with pretend horses to help people practice the game. His innovation became the first carousel.

textContent.text: The first practice carousels were very small. They had only one or two wooden horses. Still, many people enjoyed watching riders practice getting a pole through a ring while sitting on pretend horses. They thought the machine looked like fun to ride. Soon, small carousels were being built for fairs all over Europe.

In the 1800s, an Englishman built a carousel powered by a steam engine. This brought big changes to the little ride! Thanks to steam power, carousels were able to spin much faster. In America, people designed carousel horses that could move up and down as they went around in a circle. Steam-powered carousels were also able to carry the weight of many more horses and riders.

Today's carousels run on electric motors and have mirrors, lights, music, and beautifully painted animals. There have been many changes over the years to the way carousels work and look. But the joy carousels bring to riders is one thing that has not changed.

textContent.text: Paper money is made using highly skilled people and machines. When a bill is designed, it needs to pass a couple of tests. First, it must be made in a way that makes it last a long time. It should not tear too easily. But more importantly, paper money must also be secure. It should be easy to tell if someone has tried to make a fake bill. Luckily, the U.S. Treasury, which prints money, has several ways to make sure that paper money can't be copied.

What is called "paper" money is not really paper at all. U.S. bills are mostly cotton. That's right, dollar bills are made from the same material as a T-shirt! Cotton is used because it is stronger than plain paper. Money is often passed among different people many times a day. It is balled up in people's pockets. It is folded and unfolded countless times over many years. It is even washed in washing machines. Money gets worn out, and sometimes it tears. But it does not rip or fall apart nearly as easily as real paper does.

The design of each bill depends on how much it is worth. One-dollar bills have the most basic design. They have special print that you can feel with your finger. Some bills, such as the five-dollar bill, have threads that glow different colors under certain lights. And all bills worth ten dollars or more use ink that changes color when you look at the bill from different sides. All of these things work together to make paper money hard to copy. Next time you have a chance to look at different bills, see if you can notice some of these differences yourself.

From cave drawings to photos, pictures can often say more than words alone. This is one reason why people use emojis. Emojis are small pictures often used in text messages and email. They are used to show a feeling or idea. These little pictures of faces, objects, and animals got their start in Japan. The word
comes from the Japanese words for "picture" and "character."

textContent.text: In the 1990s, it took a long time to write text messages on the first cell phones. A Japanese man named Shigetaka Kurita thought it would be faster and easier to send messages using pictures. Instead of typing "It is sunny today," you could just use a picture of the sun. Kurita came up with 176 digital pictures that became the first emojis. There were hearts, happy and sad faces, and pictures showing different kinds of weather. The emojis were fast to type and easy to understand. They could also add extra information about how the writer was feeling.
Emojis were an instant hit. People loved using emojis so much that they asked for new ones to be made. Now, there are thousands of different emojis, including ones for pizza, basketball, and animals.

Using pictures in messages can carry ideas across the world. Even people who do not speak the same language can communicate with emojis. A smiling face means happy thoughts whether you speak English or Japanese!

If one word is shorter, and there are no more letters to compare, then the shorter word comes first in alphabetical order. For example, be comes before bed.
